subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Which Android message actions should be in scope for the first core implementation of this issue?
rationale: The central copy/select gap is source-reproducible, but Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply are new native chat UX surface area and prior PRs attempted different scopes without landing.

options.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Land a narrow Android message action surface for copying whole messages and selecting text, while deferring Share and Reply until separately approved.

options.title: Approve the full action sheet
options.body: Accept the broader Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply menu if maintainers want Android chat to match messaging-app action sheets now.

options.title: Defer native message actions
options.body: Keep this issue open or close it as not planned if maintainers want to avoid expanding Android chat interaction surface for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Land a narrow Android message action surface for copying whole messages and selecting text, while deferring Share and Reply until separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android chat and Markdown path history makes this handle the strongest routing candidate for the product-scope decision.
